Reminder: this notice is for travelers using the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways.

Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers should check pet travel details before heading to the airport. This notice covers the basics you need to know for bringing an animal on board, with patient help from trained staff and a calm step-by-step review if anything needs extra attention.

For large dog travel, <<FACT F075>> Keep your documents ready, and make sure the animal is prepared for the trip in the right carrier or setup. Staff will guide you through the next steps and help keep things smooth at the desk.

For large dog travel, <<FACT F057>> If your plans change, please tell the desk as soon as you can so the team can update your file and keep the process moving without a fuss. We are here to help you sort out the details before departure.

Please visit the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help with your travel check-in and any animal-travel questions.
